answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 10037 Country: India Title: Assalam walekum, I want to ask that the qaza fast in Ramzaan can be adjusted in Eid month, which also has a sawaab, if we keep it, we will get that sawaab or not,n qaza roze will also be adjusted in it. Question: Assalam walekum, I want to ask that the qaza fast in Ramzaan can be adjusted in Eid month, which also has a sawaab, if we keep it, we will get that sawaab or not,n qaza roze will also be adjusted in it. Answer ID: 10037 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 28/28D/1429) It is sunnah to fast for 6 days in Shawwal after Eid, it has much virtue as per Hadith. But, if one keeps qadha fast of Ramadhan in Shawwal, the fasts will be valid and he will receive their rewards, but it is not right to make niyah of nafl along with fardh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
